COD.rationale: Coordinate entries (content), origin metadata (status), and grid orientation/presentation together provide content identification, presentation/organization and a distinct origin/status for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content identifiers (p0/current/nX/color) together with coordinate values.

D.rationale: Each content entry is accompanied by separate origin metadata, distinguishing content identification from its recorded origin/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies grid orientation and gives explicit coordinates that represent how content is presented.
